item.name: Fresh venue has UNKNOWN crowd status
Report PACKED from user u1 again
Verify u1 latest report before u2 submits

exec: pm.test("Latest report replaces earlier vote", () => { pm.expect(data.reportCount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(data.crowdLevel).to.eql("PACKED"); });

item.name: Report LIGHT for basketball at venue 9001
Report PACKED for the whole venue 9002
Reject a request without an API key
Count only each user's latest report

exec: pm.test("Counts u1 once, using the latest report", () => pm.expect(result.reportCount).to.eql(2));
pm.test("Breaks the PACKED/BUSY tie with the most recent report", () => pm.expect(result.crowdLevel).to.eql("BUSY"));
pm.test("Sorts venues by distance", () => pm.expect(result.venues.map(v => v.venueId)).to.eql([9001, 9002, 9003]));
pm.test("Least crowded venue is 9001 (LIGHT beats PACKED)", () => pm.expect(result.leastCrowdedVenueId).to.eql(9001));
pm.test("Venue 9003 has no reports and an unknown crowd level", () => pm.expect(result.venues[2].crowdLevel).to.be.null);
pm.test("Venue 9002 uses venue-wide PACKED fallback", () => pm.expect(result.venues.find(v => v.venueId === 9002).crowdLevel).to.eql("PACKED"));

item.name: Reject a sport a venue does not offer
Op 1 - Individual search and opening hours
Individual search returns nearest open affordable venues

exec: pm.test("Result fields and distances", () => { pm.expect(data[0]).to.include({name:"API Test Search Origin",hourlyPrice:10,isIndoor:true,available:true}); pm.expect(data[0].memberDistancesKm).to.eql([0]); pm.expect(data[1].distanceKm).to.be.closeTo(1.111949,0.000001); pm.expect(data[1].averageDistanceKm).to.eql(data[1].distanceKm); });

item.name: Default budget includes only free offerings

exec: pm.test("Default zero budget", () => { pm.expect(data.map(v => v.venueId)).to.eql([9016]); pm.expect(data[0].hourlyPrice).to.eql(0); });

item.name: No sport offerings yields empty results
Group sorts by member average rather than center distance
Radius applies to center even when members are farther away
No nearby offering differs from no valid alternative
Nearby but unaffordable yields empty alternatives
Past original remains invalid with date permission
Limit and ordering for many alternatives

exec: pm.test("Ten sorted unique alternatives", () => { pm.expect(data).to.have.lengthOf(10); const keys=data.map(a=>[a.venue.venueId,a.date,a.time].join("/")); pm.expect(new Set(keys).size).to.eql(10); pm.expect(data[0].date).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("tuesday")); pm.expect(data[0].time).to.eql("12:00:00"); pm.expect(data[0].venue.venueId).to.eql(9010); });
